code_origin: Agent-authored pure compute(structure); one preregistered representation family
scientific_scope: 24 standalone input-only features; a fixed-learner ablation must determine accuracy benefit. No accuracy evaluation here.
motivation: Joint neighbor chemical contrasts and angular arrangement can distinguish local environments collapsed by scalar two-step graph summaries. Relation-aware inspiration does not imply ALIGNN architecture, neural model, or checkpoint reuse.

channel_definitions.en_ratio: (EN_neighbor-EN_center)/(EN_neighbor+EN_center), set0 if either EN<=0; historical0 denotes missing EN
channel_definitions.unlike_element: 1 if neighbor atomic number differs from center, else0

radial_weight: exp(-(distance/(covalent_radius_center+covalent_radius_neighbor))^2), normalized by sum radial weights at each center; no learned scales
neighbor_policy: All supplied directed periodic6angstrom edges; Cartesian relative vector=(frac_neighbor+image-frac_center)@lattice; zero-distance edges ignored
angular_kernel: Per channel coefficients b_e=w_e*channel_e/sum(w). Q_l=sum_e,f b_e*b_f*P_l(u_e dot u_f), l=1,2,3, including diagonal pairs.
aggregation: For each12 site powers, material unweighted site mean then population std (ddof0); intensive under cell replication
edge_cases: Empty center gives twelve0; empty edge graph gives24zeros. Negative roundoff of positive-semidefinite angular power is clipped to0. MissingEN contributes no EN-channel coefficient.
complexity: O(periodic_edges*4*27 + sites*12); no neighbor-pair matrix in submitted compute
falsification: Reject on any geometry or batch-invariance failure, nonfinite/constant/internal-duplicate output, affine scalar duplicate against fixed66 or all12 prior matrices, or poor accuracy in the later separately frozen fixed-learner ablation. Do not substitute another family after viewing outcome.
